name: calendar_delete
description: Asks the user to delete one event of their Google Calendar. It deletes nothing: it leaves a request that the user confirms or dismisses with a button in the chat, and only their click deletes. Use it when the user asks to remove, cancel or move an event (to move one, calendar_create the new time first, then this for the old one) and only for the event they named, by its number from the last calendar_agenda. Events with guests, repeating events and multi-day events are refused at the click. Returns one line saying the request is waiting for the user.

number.description: Event number from the last calendar_agenda (e.g. 2).
